test-set.name: query-bindings
test-set.description: The queryBinding attribute and what each binding allows. A case that depends on a binding names it; an implementation that does not support that binding shall fail with an error (6.5).

test-case.name: binding-xslt2
test-case.description: A schema with queryBinding="xslt2" (the context //item is both an XSLT pattern and an XPath expression).

test-case.name: binding-xslt3
test-case.description: A schema with queryBinding="xslt3" (the context //item is both an XSLT pattern and an XPath expression).

test-case.name: binding-xpath2
test-case.description: A schema with queryBinding="xpath2" (the context //item is both an XSLT pattern and an XPath expression).

test-case.name: binding-xpath3
test-case.description: A schema with queryBinding="xpath3" (the context //item is both an XSLT pattern and an XPath expression).

test-case.name: binding-xpath31
test-case.description: A schema with queryBinding="xpath31" (the context //item is both an XSLT pattern and an XPath expression).

test-case.name: binding-xquery3
test-case.description: A schema with queryBinding="xquery3".

test-case.name: binding-xquery31
test-case.description: A schema with queryBinding="xquery31".

test-case.name: binding-upper-case
test-case.description: A binding name in any mix of upper and lower case names the same binding: XSLT3.

test-case.name: binding-mixed-case
test-case.description: A binding name in any mix of upper and lower case: XPath31.

test-case.name: binding-unknown
test-case.description: An implementation that does not support the binding a schema names fails with an error.

test-case.name: binding-default
test-case.description: Without queryBinding the default binding, xslt, is used. The test gives the same result in XPath 1.0 and later versions.

test-case.name: binding-xslt
test-case.description: queryBinding="xslt", with a test that gives the same result in XPath 1.0 and later versions.

test-case.name: binding-xslt-version-sensitive
test-case.description: A comparison whose result differs between XPath 1.0 (numbers) and later versions (strings): how an implementation reads the xslt binding decides it.

result.implementation-defined: Under XPath 1.0 the strings are compared as numbers and nothing is reported; an implementation that reads xslt with a later XPath reports at /Q{}doc[1].

test-case.name: binding-xslt3-function
test-case.description: Under xslt3 an xsl:function child of the schema can be called from tests.

test-case.name: binding-xslt2-function
test-case.description: Under xslt2 an xsl:function child of the schema can be called from tests.

test-case.name: binding-xslt3-key
test-case.description: Under xslt3 an xsl:key child of the schema can be used with key().

finding.message: The line names a known product.

test-case.name: binding-xslt3-include
test-case.description: Under xslt3 an xsl:include child of the schema brings in a stylesheet module whose functions the tests may call.

test-case.name: binding-xslt3-maps
test-case.description: Under xslt3 the query language is XPath 3.x: maps are available.

test-case.name: binding-xpath2-no-maps
test-case.description: Under xpath2 the query language is XPath 2.0, which has no map constructor.

test-case.name: binding-xpath31-no-user-functions
test-case.description: Under xpath31 no user-written functions are available: an xsl:function child of the schema does not define one.

test-case.name: binding-xpath31-relative-context
test-case.description: Under the xpath bindings a rule context is an XPath expression; the binding does not say what it is evaluated against.

result.implementation-defined: Read as an XSLT-style pattern, item 2 is reported; evaluated from the document node, item selects nothing.

test-case.name: binding-xpath31-root-context
test-case.description: The xpath bindings list elements, attributes, comments and processing instructions as rule contexts, not the document node.

result.implementation-defined: An implementation that allows the document node reports at /.

test-case.name: binding-xslt2-no-backwards-compatibility
test-case.description: Under xslt2 backwards compatibility mode is off: comparing a number with a string is a type error.

test-case.name: binding-xslt3-text-value-template
test-case.description: Text value templates in messages: the extent to which they are supported is implementation-defined.

result.implementation-defined: The message is "Value 2." where text value templates are expanded, "Value {@n}." where they are not.

test-case.name: binding-xquery-context-from-root
test-case.description: Under the xquery bindings a rule context is evaluated with the document node as initial context item: item selects only the document element.

test-case.name: binding-xquery-text-context
test-case.description: Under the xquery bindings text nodes may be rule contexts.
